inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped MySQL query folds key/value attribute rows into one JSON object per owning identifier with JSON_OBJECTAGG.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored catalog attribute report. Products are joined to their attribute rows, JSON_OBJECTAGG builds one attribute map per product, and deterministic product ordering stabilizes the result set. The schema, rows, key names, values, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Products 10, 20, and 30 each have one non-NULL attribute. One key per product removes JSON_OBJECTAGG member-order ambiguity while retaining one grouped JSON object per catalog item.
determinism_notes: The report orders by the unique product ID. Each aggregate has one unique attribute key, and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_products (product_id INT PRIMARY KEY, product_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE catalog_attributes (attribute_id INT PRIMARY KEY, product_id INT NOT NULL, attribute_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, attribute_value VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, JSON_OBJECTAGG(a.attribute_name, a.attribute_value) AS attributes FROM catalog_products p INNER JOIN catalog_attributes a ON a.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_id
